finding: The generator treats the absence of enumerated issues as a positive semantic decision. The put helper assigns PRODUCT_OSS by default; generic keyword hits satisfy a locator gate. There is no required explicit current author adjudication that can preserve the missing-mechanism rationale as a blocking gate.
shared_legacy_prose_to_reconcile_in_the_: rest and webhook retain the websocket-pending sentence from the grouped selection.
deduplication retains the sentence about inbox/exactly-once gaps even though those concepts were later overridden.
proposed_guard: Require AUTHOR_SOURCE_MATCH explicitly, a current selection fingerprint, bound base/application excerpts, provenance, reasoning and remaining_gates == []. Missing/stale/pending judgments emit issues instead of a positive status.
migration_limit: Do not mass-fill the adjudication ledger from the old green matrix. Use actual author source judgments and the independent first-pass results, bound to the unchanged selections; repair findings require a new current judgment.
independent_review: A bound explicit author judgment still does not prove semantic correctness. The independent reviewer retains authority.
